LLMConfig.description:
Root LLM configuration model.

Validates the complete LLM provider/profile structure with schema versioning.

default_profile.description: Default profile name when none specified
default_profile.title: Default Profile

LLMConfig.title: LLMConfig

ProfileConfig.description:
Profile tier definition (like AWS EC2 instance sizes).

Defines a named configuration that references a provider and specifies
model parameters. Profiles enable right-sizing models for different tasks.

description.description: Human-readable description of profile use case
description.title: Description

provider.description: Provider name (must reference a key in providers section)
provider.title: Provider

ProfileConfig.title: ProfileConfig

ProviderConfig.description:
Provider infrastructure definition (reusable).

Defines connection details and defaults for an LLM provider endpoint.

api_key_secret.description: Secret key name for API authentication. Maps to WORKFLOW_SECRET_{KEY_NAME} environment variable.
api_key_secret.title: Api Key Secret

api_url.description: API endpoint URL (optional, uses provider defaults if not specified)
api_url.title: Api Url

extra_headers.description: Custom HTTP headers to include in all requests to this provider. Values can use {ENV_VAR} syntax for runtime environment variable resolution.
extra_headers.title: Extra Headers

max_retries.description: Maximum retry attempts for failed requests
max_retries.title: Max Retries

model.description: Default model for this provider (optional, can be overridden in profile)
model.title: Model

retry_delay.description: Initial retry delay in seconds (exponential backoff)
retry_delay.title: Retry Delay

type.description: Provider type (openai, anthropic, gemini, ollama, azure-openai)
type.title: Type
